title: GreenTaxiStreamingEvent
description: Contract for one dummy NYC Green Taxi event generated for June-July 2025 and published through Pub/Sub.

event_id.description: Unique UUID used for at-least-once delivery deduplication.

event_time.description: Historical business-event time, equal to pickup_datetime.

ingestion_time.description: Actual UTC time when the Python publisher generated the event.

pickup_datetime.description: Simulated pickup time from 2025-06-01 through 2025-07-31 UTC.

dropoff_datetime.description: Simulated drop-off after pickup and strictly before August 2025.

trip_distance.description: Positive simulated trip distance in miles.

fare_amount.description: Nonnegative simulated base and distance fare in US dollars.

tip_amount.description: Nonnegative simulated gratuity in US dollars.

tolls_amount.description: Nonnegative simulated toll charge in US dollars.

total_amount.description: Positive complete simulated passenger charge in US dollars.

payment_type.description: Categorical payment code accepted by this project.

source_type.description: Lineage marker distinguishing the generated streaming source.
